record.evidence_quote: The total resistance (including the bulk and grain-boundary resistances) of c- and t-Na3SbS4 are 80 Ω and 127 Ω, respectively, from which the ionic conductivities are calculated to be 2.8 and 1.77 mS/cm.
record.notes: Value 2.8 mS/cm is for c-Na3SbS4 (HBM1), assigned from the 80 Ω total resistance listed first; the pellet was cold-pressed at ~300 MPa with no sintering. Activation energy 0.06 eV is for c-Na3SbS4 from the Arrhenius plot. Conductivity derived from total resistance, so kind is recorded as total.

record.evidence_quote: The total resistance (including the bulk and grain-boundary resistances) of c- and t-Na3SbS4 are 80 Ω and 127 Ω, respectively, from which the ionic conductivities are calculated to be 2.8 and 1.77 mS/cm.
record.notes: Value 1.77 mS/cm is for t-Na3SbS4 (LBM1, 20 h low-energy ball milled), assigned from the 127 Ω total resistance listed second. The paper gives two activation energies for t-Na3SbS4 (0.25 eV tetragonal segment, 0.08 eV cubic segment), so activation energy is left null as ambiguous. Conductivity derived from total resistance.
